title: Topic-अनुसारको vocabulary र सुरक्षित upgrade
blocks: Task 2-का topic समाजका केही निश्चित क्षेत्रबाट आउँछन्। हरेक क्षेत्रका २०–२५ वटा शब्द थाहा भए जुनसुकै question-मा idea र भाषा दुवै छिटो आउँछन्। तलको सूचीमा Band 7–8 essay-मा सुरक्षित रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न सकिने शब्द मात्र राखिएका छन् — दुर्लभ, देखावटी शब्द होइनन्। हरेक शब्दको छेउमा नेपाली अर्थ र एउटा वाक्य दिइएको छ।

title: Exercise (उत्तरसहित) र साप्ताहिक practice plan
blocks: Exercise 1 · प्रकार चिन्नुहोस् — A (argumentative), N (narrative), C (combination)
1. Many people believe zoos should be closed. To what extent do you agree?
2. What are the causes of childhood obesity, and what can be done to reduce it?
3. Some think university should be free; others think students should pay. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
4. More people are working from home. Why is this? Is it a positive or negative development?
5. Discuss the advantages and disadvantages of international tourism.
6. Advertising aimed at children is harmful.
7. Should governments spend money on space exploration?
8. What problems does traffic congestion cause in big cities?
**उत्तर:** 1 A · 2 N · 3 A · 4 C · 5 N · 6 A (statement मात्र) · 7 A (yes/no) · 8 N (problem मात्र)
1. Although the metro is cheap, but many people prefer taxis.
2. Because the exam was hard, so most students failed.
3. Despite of the rain, the match continued.
4. Even though he studied a lot, however he did not pass.

**उत्तर:** 1 Although the metro is cheap, many people prefer taxis. / The metro is cheap, but … · 2 Because the exam was hard, most students failed. / The exam was hard, so … · 3 Despite the rain, … (despite-पछि "of" आउँदैन) · 4 Even though he studied a lot, he did not pass. / He studied a lot; however, he did not pass.
शब्दहरू: however · for instance · as a result · moreover · in conclusion

Online shopping has grown rapidly. ___(1), it is convenient and often cheaper. ___(2), consumers can compare prices on several sites in minutes. ___(3), it has drawbacks: returns are slow and local shops lose customers. ___(4), many high streets have empty units. ___(5), online shopping is useful but has costs for communities.
**उत्तर:** 1 Moreover (वा To begin with) · 2 For instance · 3 However · 4 As a result · 5 In conclusion
4. Prices increased ___ $500, reaching their highest level.
**उत्तर:** 1 by … between · 2 from … to · 3 at · 4 to
Students today face many pressures. Students must pass exams, students must find part-time work, and students also have to manage social media.
**एउटा नमुना उत्तर:** Students today face many pressures. They must pass exams and find part-time work, and young people also have to manage social media.
Exercise 6 · Drift खोज्नुहोस् — कुन वाक्य paragraph-मा हुनु हुँदैन?

(1) Public transport should be free in large cities. (2) Free buses would reduce the number of cars and therefore cut pollution. (3) They would also help poorer residents reach jobs across the city. (4) My uncle drives a bus and says the traffic gets worse every year. (5) Several European cities that have tried free transport report cleaner air and busier city centres.
**उत्तर:** वाक्य 4 — यो traffic-को बारेमा भए पनि "transport should be free" भन्ने दाबीलाई support गर्दैन, र यो तर्कको सट्टा व्यक्तिगत कथा हो।
1. This is undoubtedly the main cause.
3. It is beyond doubt that exercise improves health.
4. Perhaps some students would prefer online classes.
5. This is the least the government can do.
**उत्तर:** 1 E · 2 S · 3 E · 4 S · 5 E ("least" ले यहाँ जोड दिन्छ)
Exercise 8 · Overview लेख्नुहोस् (संख्या बिना, एउटै वाक्यमा)
**एउटा नमुना उत्तर:** Overall, unemployment fell steadily for most of the period before rising slightly in the final years, finishing well below its starting level.
Some people think children should be taught to compete; others think they should be taught to cooperate. Discuss both views and give your opinion.
**एउटा नमुना उत्तर:** While competition can motivate a few high achievers, I believe that teaching children to cooperate produces more capable and happier adults.

Nowadays, many childrens are spending too much time on the phone. This is effect their study and their health. Parents should to limit the screen time, because it is very important for the future of the children, and also they can play outside more, and so it will be better.

**उत्तर:** childrens → children · This is effect → This is affecting (verb, continuous) · should to limit → should limit · the screen time → screen time · अन्तिम वाक्य run-on हो ("and… and… so") — यसलाई टुक्र्याउनुहोस्: …for their future. They would also play outside more, which would be better for their health. (साथै "on the phone" → "on their phones")
Governments should ban all advertising aimed at children. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
गर्नुहोस्: subject matter-मा रेखा तान्नुहोस् → for/against को दुई column → rank गर्नुहोस् → पक्ष रोज्नुहोस् → introduction (general + thesis) लेख्नुहोस्। त्यसपछि तलको plan-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्।

**एउटा नमुना plan:** For: children cannot judge advertising; junk-food ads drive obesity; pester power strains families. Against: ads fund children's TV; parents, not the state, should decide; a ban is hard to enforce online. पक्ष: agree (for-का तर्क बलिया छन्, र against-का तर्कको जवाफ दिन सकिन्छ)। Thesis: Although a ban may be difficult to enforce online, I firmly believe that children need this protection because they cannot recognise persuasion for what it is.
Exercise 12 · Task 1 — यो table-का लागि introduction + overview लेख्नुहोस्

**एउटा नमुना उत्तर:** The table compares the percentage of commuters using five forms of transport in one city in 2000 and 2020. Overall, the car remained the most common choice in both years but lost a substantial share, while rail and cycling grew markedly and walking was unchanged.
अध्याय १-को एउटा भाग पढ्नुहोस्; Exercise 2–3; १० वटा topic-शब्द
एउटा Task 1 (line/bar) २० मिनेटमा; अध्याय २-को checklist-सँग दाँजेर हेर्नुहोस्
तीनवटा Task 2 question-को plan मात्र (प्रकार, दुई column, thesis) — लेख्ने होइन
एउटा Task 2 ४० मिनेटमा; अध्याय १-को self-test ले आफैँ मार्क गर्नुहोस्
AI feedback पढेर मंगलबारको essay फेरि लेख्नुहोस्; Band 7 sample-सँग तुलना गर्नुहोस्
आफ्नो error log review गर्नुहोस्; १० वटा topic-शब्द; आराम

**Error log कसरी राख्ने:** एउटै पानामा तीन column — गल्ती · सुधार · कति पटक। हरेक लेखाइपछि नयाँ गल्ती थप्नुहोस्। परीक्षाको अन्तिम ५ मिनेटमा सबैभन्दा धेरै पटक आउने तीनवटा गल्ती मात्र खोज्नुहोस्। एक महिनाभित्रै धेरैजसो student-का top-3 गल्ती बदलिन्छन् — अर्थात् पहिलेका गल्ती सच्चिइसकेका हुन्छन्।
यहीँ किताब सकियो। हरेक अध्यायको checklist एकैसाथ प्रिन्ट गरेर आफ्नो अगाडि राख्नुहोस्; हरेक practice-पछि त्यसैले आफूलाई मार्क गर्नुहोस्। Writing-मा band बानीले बढ्छ, जादूले होइन।
